scope: Repository path-to-accountability map for checklist SL-00-15. Roles identify the accountable engineering function, not a named person or GitHub team.
github_codeowners_blocker: No verified GitHub usernames or teams were available; assigning synthetic CODEOWNERS identities would create invalid ownership claims.

domains.responsibility: Provider adapters, ingestion, source timestamps, permissions metadata, and point-in-time data handling.
Simulated orders, fills, session lifecycle, replay semantics, and paper execution evidence.
Learning algorithms, policy evaluation, and controlled adaptation.
Hypothesis registration, trial eligibility, strategy versioning, evidence claims, and promotion records.
Pre-trade and portfolio risk constraints, breach handling, and safety stops.
Portfolio construction, capital allocation, instrument eligibility, and cross-position exposure.
Trader-facing workflows, APIs, briefs, alerts, and explanations.
Cash, positions, fees, realized and unrealized P&L, and reconciliation.

overlap_rule: A path may appear in multiple domains when its responsibilities genuinely cross-cut; each domain remains separately accountable for its stated responsibility.
activation_requirement: Before using this as GitHub CODEOWNERS policy, replace null human_owner values with verified GitHub users or teams and validate those identities against the repository organization.
